title: Engineering Abaxent
summaryLead: A fast, framework-free site for a network of technology professionals.
summaryMore: Hand-written CSS, a scroll-driven video hero and one self-contained page.

stack.name: Hosting
stack.detail: Static files on an edge CDN.

stack.name: Runtime
stack.detail: Vanilla JavaScript. No framework or UI library.

stack.name: Styling
stack.detail: Hand-written CSS with design tokens, Grid and clamp(). Dark mode via prefers-color-scheme.

stack.name: Hero media
stack.detail: Muted looping MP4 with a poster frame. Paused for reduced motion.

stack.name: Brand graphics
stack.detail: One inline SVG sprite, recoloured with CSS variables.

stack.name: Type
stack.detail: System sans stack plus one italic serif accent, Instrument Serif.

chapters.title: Brand shapes with no image files
chapters.challenge: Keep the pyramid motif sharp at any size without raster images.
chapters.solution: An inline SVG sprite coloured through CSS variables.
chapters.outcome: Vector-sharp on every screen, with no image payload.

chapters.title: Intro and full-screen menu
chapters.challenge: A cinematic intro that does not delay first paint.
chapters.solution: CSS keyframe overlays toggled by small state classes.
chapters.outcome: The intro clears itself and the content stays reachable.

chapters.title: Scroll-driven video hero
chapters.challenge: Open on a film without hurting speed, scroll or keyboard use.
chapters.solution: Hero media grows to full-bleed on a CSS variable. The menu uses inert, aria-expanded and Escape.
chapters.outcome: A cinematic first screen that respects motion preferences.

chapters.title: Fluid layout
chapters.challenge: Keep multi-column layouts readable from phone to ultra-wide.
chapters.solution: CSS Grid with fluid clamping and per-item width variables.
chapters.outcome: Readable at every width, with few breakpoints.

chapters.title: Credential and project carousels
chapters.challenge: Show twelve credentials and nine project photos without a carousel library.
chapters.solution: Native scroll-snap with drag, active-slide state and disabled end buttons.
chapters.outcome: Touch, mouse and keyboard all browse the same content.

results.title: Performance
results.text: Fast first paint from one static page with no framework runtime.

results.title: Maintainability
results.text: One token set drives the whole design.

results.title: Resilience
results.text: Plain web standards, so there is little to break or update.
